diffusers.reason: MiniMax-H3 is in no diffusers release. Same commit baseline/SOURCE_SNAPSHOT.json pins.

transformer.note: FP8 E4M3 with per-layer comfy_quant scheme and a rank-8 adaln_t_table.

text_encoder.note: H3's text_encoder/config.json is stock Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, so this is the same model at half the bytes.

transformer_bf16_reference.note: Needed only to measure the FP8 port against the released model. Not on the run path.

environment.note: The versions are load-bearing: installing torchvision separately once pulled torch to 2.13.0 and Triton to 3.7, which would have silently invalidated every bit-exactness result in checks/ without failing anything.

hardware.memory_kind: unified LPDDR5X shared with the host
